We will collaborate closely with your team to identify key performance indicators (KPIs) that align with your business goals, ensuring that affiliates are rewarded for driving valuable traffic. The deliverables will include a detailed commission structure proposal, a set of guidelines for affiliates, and a performance tracking plan to monitor the effectiveness of the commission model. This structured approach will not only enhance affiliate engagement but also optimize your overall marketing efforts, leading to increased sales and brand visibility.
deliverables: Consultation sessions for feedback and adjustments (consultation)
